label: Every SERIES_OF_CAUSES_4 link is a PER_SE_5 actual CAUSE_2 of being
paraphrase: OPEN analyst bridge, attribution deferred, e8664ab8 restated on SERIES_OF_CAUSES_4: whenever here and now c efficiently causes the being of x per se, as caused (CausesBeingAsCaused, definition 57348ddc), c is a per se actual cause of the being of x in the q.3 a.4 profile (PerSeActualEsseCause, PER_SE_5): c is other than x, both are in act as to being, CausesIn c x esse (CAUSE_2, mode unspecified, tenseless) and AsCaused c x. The per se conjunct is shared with the antecedent, so the content is the passage from present efficient causing of being to a distinct actual cause of being. The hand-and-stick case that falsifies e8664ab8 on SERIES_OF_CAUSES_3 does not touch it: the hand causes the stick's motion, not its being, so it is no SERIES_OF_CAUSES_4 link. No substantive objection identified beyond the shared reading of the world-free InAct of the q.3 a.4 profile as being in act at the reading world.

connection_plan.missing_bridge: Independently supply present existential predecessors for actual distinct-esse bearers: at each step, either a terminal actual esse-is-essence giver with an actual esse edge, or a distinct-esse giver with a SERIES_OF_CAUSES_4 edge. Descend under independently supplied SERIES_OF_CAUSES_4 accessibility and use the conversion of each nonterminal edge to PER_SE_5 actual causation to build the actual esse chain.
connection_plan.blocker: The existing bridge can help obtain existential accessibility only by starting from the PER_SE_5 regress. Returning to that same regress is circular for this producer. A genuine forward consumer needs independently justified coverage of actual distinct-esse bearers by the present existential predecessor step, including why a continuing giver causes as caused.
